{{Quote|The classic! A grilled-to-perfection patty topped with all the fixin's&mdash;a slice of Gonzo yellow cheese, Revwien lettuce, topato slices, grilled Ojomian onions and B'omarr-style pickles.|Dex's Diner menu, regarding the Coruscant slider|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Gonzo yellow cheese''' was a type of [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]] enjoyed by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] and used in his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> One slice of the cheese was served on Jettster's [[Coruscant slider]], a dish inspired by the eponymous planet and the [[Time/Legends|time]] he had spent there. [[Pashi noodles]], another diner dish, were served with [[Gonzo yellow cheese sauce]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gonzo [[Color/Legends|yellow]] cheese is mentioned in a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive release, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the style of an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="Menu" /> The word "gonzo" is a slang term that exists within the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], one that acts as a positive adjective,<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|news/13516_5.html|Senate Speeder Thief Arrested}}</ref> although only a nominal connection between the word and the cheese is made in Walker's work.<ref name="Menu" />
